description: Provides an AuthProvider class managing authentication state, session persistence, user data retrieval, and real-time service connection for a Flutter app. Handles login, logout, session loading, and supports mock mode for testing.

classes.name: AuthProvider
classes.description: Manages authentication state, token persistence, user data, and real-time service connections in a Flutter app. Extends ChangeNotifier for reactive updates.

methods.name: AuthProvider._
methods.description: Private constructor initializing API and real-time services with dependency injection.

methods.name: AuthProvider.factory
methods.description: Factory constructor creating an AuthProvider with token getter for API and real-time services.

methods.name: _tokenGetter
methods.description: Static method returning the current token from local storage asynchronously.

methods.name: loadSession
methods.description: Loads existing user session from local storage or via API, updates internal state, and connects real-time service if applicable.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs user login, supports mock mode, handles token extraction from API responses, fetches user info if needed, and updates state.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears session tokens, disconnects real-time service, and resets user data.
